title: Epi part of affine-basis section resolution comparison
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], V an affine open, and F,J integer-indexed complexes of module sheaves [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Suppose J is K-injective [def-pur-kinjective-complex] and i:F → J is a quasi-isomorphism. For every affine W contained in V, assume all positive cohomology groups [def-sc-sheaf-cohomology-functor] of each term of F, each differential cokernel of F, and each cohomology sheaf of F restricted to W vanish. For every integer n, the map H^n(Γ(V,F)) → H^n(Γ(V,J)) induced by i is an epimorphism of O_X(V)-modules. The section complexes are formed by termwise native module evaluation. Empty V is allowed; no boundedness or quasi-coherence is assumed.

source.place: Tag 08C2, lemma-alternating-cech-complex-complex-ss, singleton cover; Tag 071B, lemma-K-injective. Source TeX read in sandbox scratchpad/cohomology.tex.

proof.text: Use the finite cokernel and homology acyclicity argument to obtain preservation of left homology for F.
Transport homology vanishing through the quasi-isomorphism i and exact restriction. Obtain preservation of left homology for the K-injective resolution J.

Mathlib mapHomologyIso_hom_naturality gives H(S(i)) followed by the J comparison as the F comparison followed by S(H(i)). Both comparisons and H(i) are invertible, so H(S(i)) is invertible and in particular epi.

theorem affineBasisSections_resolution_homology_epi
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (V : X.Opens) (hV : IsAffineOpen V)
    (F J : CochainComplex X.Modules ℤ) [J.IsKInjective]
    (i : F ⟶ J) [QuasiIso i]
    (hterms : ∀ (W : X.Opens), IsAffineOpen W → W ≤ V → ∀ (n : ℤ) (q : ℕ),
      Subsingleton (((F.X n).restrict W.ι).H (q + 1)))
    (hcokernels : ∀ (W : X.Opens), IsAffineOpen W → W ≤ V → ∀ (n : ℤ) (q : ℕ),
      Subsingleton (((cokernel (F.d (n - 1) n)).restrict W.ι).H (q + 1)))
    (hhomology : ∀ (W : X.Opens), IsAffineOpen W → W ≤ V → ∀ (n : ℤ) (q : ℕ),
      Subsingleton (((F.homology n).restrict W.ι).H (q + 1))) (n : ℤ) :
    let S := SheafOfModules.evaluation.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) (op V)
    letI : S.Additive := inferInstanceAs
      ((SheafOfModules.forget.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) ⋙
        PresheafOfModules.evaluation.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).obj (op V)).Additive)
    Epi (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
      ((S.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map i) n)
